coverage.name: Gilpin County
limitations: Excluded: Gilpin County Ballot Issue 1A (referred by Resolution 26-077) retains revenue "FOR CORE INFRASTRUCTURE AND MAINTENANCE INCLUDING ROADS, BRIDGES, WILDFIRE AND FLOOD MITIGATION"; no housing earmark.
Excluded: Timberline Fire Protection District Ballot Issue 7B (fire district mill levy); not housing.
The posted sample ballots are JPEG images with no text layer; they were read visually.
No list of participating political subdivisions and no mailed TABOR notice was posted as of 2026-09-26.

coverage.name: Black Hawk (city)
limitations: The city clerk elections page (cityofblackhawk.org) returned HTTP 403 to automated access on 2026-09-26 and was not read.

The county has posted two sample ballot styles (General; Central City). Neither contains a City of Black Hawk contest or question. With no participating-entities list posted, participation could not be confirmed or ruled out.

coverage.name: Central City (city)
limitations: Participating for candidates only: the city Call for Candidates states "A Regular Mail Ballot Election coordinated with Gilpin County Clerk & Recorder will be held on Tuesday, November 3, 2026 to fill the Mayor seat and two (2) Alderman seats". The Central City sample ballot carries no city ballot question.
The posted sample ballots are JPEG images with no text layer; they were read visually.
